title: REEB and Cane Creek Announce Limited Edition STEEZL x Invert Enduro Chassis Kit
content:
REEB Cycles is no stranger to limited-edition builds, and they’re at it again with Cane Creek, this time collaborating on a limited-edition STEEZL x Invert Chassis Kit. Available to order for the month of October only, this collaboration pairs the new and somewhat rare Cane Creek Invert Enduro fork with a STEEZL frame in a custom finish inspired by Cane Creek’s new Slate Chroma Studio color. 

“We didn’t want to take an Invert, bolt it onto a STEEZL and call it a collaboration,” said Jeff Lenosky, Brand Director at REEB Cycles. “Cane Creek’s new Slate color gave us the opportunity to treat the entire chassis as a one-off custom project. The dual satin/gloss powder finish, frame and fork graphics, headset, black-anodized hardware, and suspension package create this limited edition chassis and what makes this collaboration worth doing.”

Built in-house by REEB in Colorado and featuring American-made rockers, hardware, and seat clamp, the 155mm travel STEEZL frame is done up with a custom, dual-finish Lux Nightfall powder coat. That’s complemented by the Slate accents of the Cane Creek Hellbender 70 headset, black anodized  suspension hardware, and matching graphics on the frame and fork.

This limited-edition Chassis Kit is centered around Cane Creek’s new Invert Enduro fork at 170mm of travel. Officially launched back in April, the upside-down Invert Enduro fork has been highly sought after and in relatively short supply — it is currently sold out in all travel lengths. For the rear shock, buyers can choose between the Cane Creek Kitsuma Coil, Kitsuma Air, or the unique Tigon air-charged coil shock.

Chassis Kit Features

  • REEB STEEZL 155mm-travel chassis handcrafted in Colorado
  • Custom dual-finish Lux Nightfall powder coat inspired by Cane Creek Slate
  • Cane Creek Invert Enduro fork
  • Cane Creek Hellbender 70 Slate Chroma Studio headset
  • Exclusive matching REEB frame and Invert Enduro fork decal package with Slate accents
  • Black-anodized Prosise Metal Works rockers and hardware
  • Choice of Cane Creek Kitsuma Coil, Kitsuma Air, or Tigon rear shock
  • 4–6 week estimated lead time

Pricing and Availability

The limited edition STEEZL x Invert Chassis Kit starts at $5,462 and includes everything listed above. The price may increase slightly depending on the rear shock choice or the addition of ISCG tabs (+$40). Complete builds are also available, with no shortage of options in REEB’s custom build configurator. 

As mentioned above, the REEB STEEZL x Cane Creek Invert Chassis Kit is available to order for the month of October only. Head to the REEB website to learn more or place an order.
